attributes.during:
Your ship is anchored at the Harbor.

When you encounter Kelizar the Brine Dragon, examine a random other open location deck until you find a henchman; banish it. Shuffle the remaining cards into that location deck. If Kelizar is defeated and cannot escape, banish Kelizar.

You win the scenario only when all locations are permanently closed.
